title: The mouth of the just meditates on wisdom
english: The mouth of the just person will meditate on wisdom (Psalm 37:30, LXX 36:30). The inner person is fed not by food and drink but by meditation on wisdom. The law opens the mouth to the word of God.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 12 (Migne) Rufinus Latin via Archive PDF pdftotext; no first-edition GCS.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Trigg FOTC / Prinzivalli SC / Perrone 2015.
After tip bee77e3c; Psalms Rufinus Homilia V in Ps 36 CLOSEOUT.
orientation: Origen is commenting on a verse from Psalm 36 (LXX), explaining how the just person's mouth is fed by meditation on wisdom rather than by food and drink.

title: Eternal light and glory to God forever
english: The one who remains in the eternity of light gives back glory to God unto ages of ages. Amen.
